- 'A synthetic leading block + body block containing `type: book-note` yields exactly

- A single-block document whose body has a `type:` line inside a fenced code block
  yields no report
- '`okf_migrate.py --repair-only` on a seeded two-block file reports it repaired,
  leaves exactly one `^---`-delimited block, and reports it unchanged on a second
  run'
- '`okf_migrate.py --repair-only --dir knowledge` reports a non-zero repairable count
  on the un-migrated tree (today `repaired: 0` / 2574)'
- 'The instrument for this clause is the fence-aware stranded-block detector built
  by clauses 2 and 3, not a line-based walk: that detector reports 0 stranded blocks
  under `~/obsidian/knowledge/`. Two carve-outs are part of the measurement, and both
  are mechanical so that no round has to make a prose judgement to reach zero. (a)
  A key run inside a fenced code block is not a stranded block — so fencing a family,
  as order of work step 3 prescribes for the digest and updates families, is a compliant
  outcome and the detector stops counting it. (b) A key line is not a stranded block
  if it sits in no delimiter-delimited block and is not contiguous with other key
  lines; the test is whether either neighbouring line matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*:[
  \t]+\S`, so a key line whose neighbours are prose is not counted. That is what excludes
  the five quoted upstream openclaw PR-template prose lines (`type: user-facing description`)
  in `knowledge/tools/openclaw/prs.md`: their neighbours are the sentences `Required
  PR title:` and `Use a parenthesized scope only when it adds clarity:`, which match
  no key pattern. Those five are excluded as prose — they must never be converted
  into real front matter and must never be re-indented to move this number. A line-based
  walk that matches a line-start `type:` below the leading block is not an acceptable
  instrument for this clause: it counts every fenced line and every prose line, so
  its only routes to zero are writing prose into real front matter or indenting prose,
  and either games the check instead of fixing the tree. The per-file dispositions
  that make zero reachable are in order of work step 3.'
- '0 files in `knowledge/youtube/AI_Engineer/` parse to a `type` other than `video-note`

- 0 files in that directory are missing `source`, `video_id`, `channel` or `published`
